item.description:
Snapbar 0.5

  • Record your voice: choose a microphone in the new Microphone menu. Pick any connected input, or follow the system default.
  • A small level meter next to the recording time moves as you speak, so you can see your microphone is being picked up.
  • With Record System Audio on as well, your voice and the system sound are mixed into one track that plays everywhere.

Snapbar 0.4

  • The smoothed cursor now moves evenly in exported recordings; it no longer stops and jumps when only the mouse is moving.
  • New click indicator: a soft white circle that grows from the click and fades out.

Snapbar 0.3

  • The window picker appears instantly after you choose it.
  • Cut in the editor: click the scissors, then click the strip where it should split.
  • Redesigned editor panel: every option is a button on the panel, with tips on hover. Click the speed and quality pills to change them.
  • Esc no longer stops a recording.
  • The size readout while dragging an area matches the rest of the glass interface.
